en: Black‑and‑white real‑photo postcard showing a cobblestoned downhill street leading to a central square. At the far side of the square stands a neoclassical church with a pedimented facade and a tall open bell tower topped by a dome. An early automobile is parked at the curb and a few pedestrians walk along the street. The back is printed in Finnish/French with a Viipuri (Vyborg) photo credit.
